messages:
Marta S.: heads up — CI is red on my PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/342, integration-tests failed on self-hosted runner

Marta S.: job log shows a KMS decrypt error, looks credential/perm related

Marta S.: ```
ERROR: KMS decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/runner-ci-sa/... is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
    at com.redwood.secrets.KmsClient.decrypt(KmsClient.java:87)
```

Devin K.: which runner? agent-03?

Marta S.: yep, eks-runner-03 (self-hosted) — started after I rebased earlier today

ci-bot: workflow "integration-tests" failed (run id 7890123) — view logs: https://ci.internal/runs/7890123

Devin K.: I rotated the runner token yesterday; maybe the IRSA role lost kms:Decrypt in the policy during the prune. @Ryan L. can you check the IAM policy for runner-ci-sa?

Ryan L.: looking now. policy change earlier removed broad kms:* and left only Describe/Tag. runner-ci-sa no longer has kms:Decrypt for that key — confirmed.

Anika P.: oof. quick unblock: either re-add kms:Decrypt to runner-ci-sa or run this job on hosted runners (but integration uses local infra so hosted won't work cleanly).

Devin K.: re-adding kms:Decrypt scoped to the specific key ARN is fastest. @ops-oncall can you approve a temporary perm add?

ops-oncall: I'm not at my desk, can approve in ~15m. If you need instant unblock, tag me in the PR for the IAM change.

Marta S.: i'll hold the merge until CI green. can someone rerun after perms are back?

Ryan L.: applying IAM update now — adding kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 to runner-ci-sa. will post when done.

Ryan L.: (5m later) IAM update applied. pushed change and annotated the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/342#issuecomment-1234

Marta S.: rerunning the workflow: `gh run rerun 7890123 --repo redwood-inference/core`

ci-bot: Rerun started for run id 7890123 (triggered by Marta S.)

ci-bot: Rerun completed — integration-tests ✅ all green

Marta S.: thanks all — unblocked. I'll add a note to infra docs to avoid pruning kms:Decrypt for runner role and file a follow-up to make this a managed policy. :memo:

Devin K.: creating infra ticket to make kms:Decrypt part of runner managed policy and add ownership guardrails. assigning to Ryan L. and Anika P.

Anika P.: will take the ticket, + add a test that simulates permission pruning in a staging account so we catch this earlier.

Marta S.: perfect. closing this thread.
